QUOTE: "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788`) forwards the empty vector. If no tokenizer is wired it also returns `{}`, so "no tokenizer", "llama.cpp error" and "empty prompt" all look the same."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the backend wrapper forwards an empty vector on failed tokenization and returns the same `{}` when no tokenizer is wired.
